package rulefixtures

import "fmt"

// scenario for interface_slice_allocation: `[]interface{}` or `[]any` used to pass homogeneous typed data
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func printNames(users []string, ages []int) {
	args := make([]any, 0, len(users)+len(ages))
	for _, u := range users {
		args = append(args, u)
	}
	for _, a := range ages {
		args = append(args, a)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%v\n", args...)
}

func collectValues(items []string) []any {
	result := make([]any, len(items))
	for i, v := range items {
		result[i] = v
	}
	return result
}
